**Review: clean. Verdict: merge-ready.** Reviewed by the SlaveSession PR-reviewer agent (built review). (A queue note at 02:13 UTC said this review was posted; it was not - no comment or label reached GitHub. This comment is the review of record.)

**Built.** Head `d06e64d36` alone, and merged with current `main` (`0b1ee6065`, trial merge with no conflicts).
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1230 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored on the merged tree (raw head: 1204 passed). No test deleted or ignored (#1953).
- `camcraft-app` `stock_play_picture`: 2 passed, 0 failed, on both trees.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Checks.**
- The transport advance goes through one new function; the old direct `sim.advance` call site is gone and no other call site or seek bypasses the hold (grep of `crates/ui/src`).
- Ephemeral playback stays immediate-mode; no new document write, so no command is owed (Everything Is a Command).
- The scrub slider is disabled while `Precalc::Running`; Play, Stop and Cancel stay live, so a slow calculation is escapable (Prime Directive: no hang a user cannot leave).
- The dt clamp (0.1 s) is kept, so a stalled frame still never teleports the tool.
- The pinning UI test fails before and passes after, per the body; the two app tests pass on both sides, which localises the defect to the clock, as the body says.
- Screenshots are absent; the reason given (a hold in time shows nothing in a still) is accepted. The tests pin the behaviour.

**Note for the merge.** #2611 stays `in-review` until the merge closes it through `Fixes #2611`.

Merge class: SAME. The head `d06e64d36c8741ac37650f6b52943fb0e757b2e0` is the reviewed head. No commit came after the review, and the PR merges cleanly with `main` without a refresh.

This merge relies on the built review of this head by the SlaveSession PR-reviewer agent (2026-11-19 04:24 UTC). The PR fixes a P3 and needs no second review.
